description: Register an AI agent wallet with the Mintware AI Attribution contract on Base mainnet. This is a one-time on-chain transaction — the wallet pays a small amount of ETH gas. After registration, the oracle watcher begins tracking the agent's on-chain activity automatically. Requires the wallet's private key. IMPORTANT: only pass a private key for wallets you control and only in a trusted, secure environment.

privateKey.description: Private key of the agent wallet to register (0x-prefixed hex, 66 characters). This key signs the registration transaction on Base mainnet.

name: mintware_register
